title: When you doubt your worth
line: For self-doubt, shame, or feeling not enough.
intro: Many people carry a quiet voice that says they are not enough. This practice answers it with an old teaching (you can be your own friend) and with the Goddess who is grace and sovereignty.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Sit comfortably, with your back upright and soft. Follow the circle: in as it grows, out as it settles. Never strain.

steps.title: Be your own friend
steps.text: Lift yourself by your own effort; do not bring yourself down. The self can be its own friend.

steps.title: Her grace
steps.text: Repeat AUM Lalitayai Namah, to the Goddess of grace and dignity.

steps.title: Something true
steps.prompt: One thing I did well, or one way I was kind, recently.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: This verse says the whole remains whole. So do you.

after: Come back to this when the voice is loud. If it never quiets, it is worth talking to someone.
